test_cases.name: TC01_GlobalProvider_InitialStateDiagnostics
test_cases.description: Verifies unconfigured empty cache diagnostics on ContentProfileProvider global provider.

test_cases.name: TC02_GlobalProvider_ConfigurePolicyA_DeclarationAndRecord
test_cases.description: Verifies valid current-v1 ConfigureExpectedPackagePolicy overloads (Declaration and Record) on global provider.

test_cases.name: TC03_GlobalProvider_CallerOwnershipAndImmutability
test_cases.description: Verifies caller list mutation on input or returned snapshot does not corrupt global provider state.

test_cases.name: TC04_GlobalProvider_GenerationAdvanceOnReconfigure
test_cases.description: Verifies legitimate reconfigure advances configuration generation and keeps cache unpopulated.

test_cases.name: TC05_GlobalProvider_ClearConfiguredPolicy_ResetsAndAdvancesGeneration
test_cases.description: Verifies ClearConfiguredExpectedPackagePolicy removes configured policy and advances generation.

test_cases.name: TC06_GlobalProvider_ExplicitInvalidateCache
test_cases.description: Verifies explicit InvalidateCache retains configured policy while ensuring empty cache state.

test_cases.name: TC07_StandaloneCore_InitialStateDiagnostics
test_cases.description: Verifies standalone core initializes with generation 0 and empty unconfigured state.

test_cases.name: TC08_StandaloneCore_ConfigurePolicyA_AdvancesGeneration
test_cases.description: Verifies configuring policy A on core advances generation to 1 and stores immutable snapshot.

test_cases.name: TC09_StandaloneCore_PublishCoherentEntryA_Success
test_cases.description: Verifies publishing coherent entry matching generation and policy succeeds and populates cache.

test_cases.name: TC10_StandaloneCore_CoherentEntryQueryRepeatAndDefensiveCopy
test_cases.description: Verifies repeated queries return identical results and mutating returned CachedManifest does not corrupt cache.

test_cases.name: TC11_StandaloneCore_ReconfigureToPolicyB_ClearsOldCache
test_cases.description: Verifies reconfiguring core with policy B advances generation to 2 and atomically invalidates entry A.

test_cases.name: TC12_StandaloneCore_PublishCoherentEntryB_Success
test_cases.description: Verifies publishing entry B at generation 2 populates core with entry B.

test_cases.name: TC13_StandaloneCore_StaleGenerationPublication_Rejected
test_cases.description: Verifies publishing with stale generation or mismatched policy is rejected without modifying cache.

test_cases.name: TC14_StandaloneCore_SamePolicyReconfigure_DeterministicAdvanceAndInvalidate
test_cases.description: Verifies same-policy reconfigure deterministically advances generation and invalidates cache.

test_cases.name: TC15_StandaloneCore_ClearConfiguredPolicy_InvalidatesEntryAndClearsPolicy
test_cases.description: Verifies ClearConfiguredExpectedPackagePolicy on populated core advances generation and invalidates entry.

test_cases.name: TC16_StandaloneCore_InvalidateCache_PreservesConfiguration
test_cases.description: Verifies InvalidateCache clears stored entry while preserving configured policy.

test_cases.name: TC17_R12_CheckPackagePolicy_ZeroBasedContiguousOrder_CopiedView
test_cases.description: Verifies R12 CheckPackagePolicy validates 0-based contiguous loadOrder using copied view without mutating caller.

test_cases.name: TC18_R12_PhysicalPermutation_CanonicalAdmittedContent
test_cases.description: Verifies R12 physical permutation invariance: permuted array yields identical canonical JSON and digest.

test_cases.name: TC19_R12_DistinctValidExecutionOrders_MatchingDistinctPolicies
test_cases.description: Verifies R12 distinct execution sequences match their separate policies and retain distinct canonical content.

test_cases.name: TC20_R12_FreshOriginal_SerializeTrue_BeforeAdmission
test_cases.description: Verifies R12 fresh-original manifest serializes with canonicalNormalize=true before external admission.

test_cases.name: TC21_R11_PolicyDeclaration_Encoding_Whitespace_Unicode_Digest
test_cases.description: Verifies R11 policy declaration compact JSON, whitespace/Unicode preservation, and SHA-256 digest.

test_cases.name: TC22_R9_VersionMeaningSemantics
test_cases.description: Regresses R9 version meaning: modVersion null/empty values preserved without overwrite.

test_cases.name: TC23_ContractVersion_And_CapabilityFlag
test_cases.description: Verifies ADR-006B-v5-R13 contract version and GATE05_R13_POLICY_CACHE_LIFECYCLE capability flag.

test_cases.name: TC24_DefFamiliesAndCanonicalSorting
test_cases.description: Regresses 8 Def families presence and canonical sorting order.
